title: The Secrets of Root Canal Treatment
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🦷🔬

Sami is a rushed dentist: 'A root canal? It's simple, I do it in 30 minutes!' Mina, an endodontics expert, corrects him: 'Not so fast, Sami! Endodontics is much more than just twisting files.'

Between irreversible pulpitis, a fractured file, a calcified canal, or a ledge, endodontics is a true art.

Instrumentation that's too quick, insufficient irrigation, and the treatment fails. A rigorous technique, perfect disinfection, and the tooth is saved.

Tooth preservation, patient health, and the longevity of restorations rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Sami is in a hurry: 'A root canal, it's simple!' Mina corrects him: 'Not so fast!' Discover the basics of endodontics: root canal treatment, pulpectomy, instrumentation, obturation.
chapters.debutant2: Sami and Mina delve deeper into complications: file fractures, ledges, perforations, open apex. They discover that endodontics is demanding.
chapters.intermediaire1: Sami and Mina master root canal treatment: instrumentation, irrigation, obturation, management of complex canals.
chapters.intermediaire2: Sami and Mina face complications and emergencies: fractures, ledges, perforations, open apex, retreatments.
chapters.expert1: Sami and Mina become endodontic references. They train young dentists in rigor and technique.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Sami and Mina leave a legacy of endodontic skills. Endodontics is the art of saving teeth.
